title: Payment idempotency
content: For payment operations, require an idempotency key, preserve the original request identifier, and reject a second request with a mismatched payload.

title: Contract version precedence
content: When a request references multiple API contract versions, prefer the highest approved version and return the source version used as evidence.

title: Audit traceability
content: Every integration decision must preserve a correlation identifier, source system, and timestamp for audit review.
